author: HensHaveEars2
title: This is an addition to my third review
content:
I love the game. The artwork is the best. True to your word, you are continually changing things to make the gameplay better and better. Thank you! I have one request. I will not play tasks relating to spiritism. Pretty soon I will not be able to play at all because of the summoning items, crystal balls, etc. that I am required to collect to complete the tasks. Could you perhaps add a feature where we can trash or replace orders that we don’t want to do? You could even attach a penalty, like 1000 coins or 100 diamonds. That way, I could still play. Thank you for considering this.

Additionally, you’re in-app purchases are way too high. Since we are dealing with digital items, it doesn’t cost you more if you give us 1000 diamonds rather than 100 diamonds. Why not be generous with what you give us when we pay? I’m sure people will pay (and play) more frequently when the cost is minimal, which could add up to be the same thing for you in profit.  If you give people really good value for their money, they tend to spend more. I play another game frequently where they are constantly offering really good items for $.99. And for an extraordinarily large bundle, they might ask for $5.99. Your prices are way beyond that, and frankly not worth it because of how quickly resources get used up. I don’t think your average gamer has lots of money to spare. And there are probably way more of them than those who can afford your high prices. Something to consider.

author: Lizzie110148
title: Love the game & Support Team BUT going broke!
content: I found this game while sick, depressed and having anxiety. It was amazing how much it helped me! I really can’t explain why it worked when so many other things did not. I even told my doctor!  The graphics are great, the main game is engaging and there are side games and events that keep things busy and interesting. I have had many questions, some technical issues…and I have frequently written to Support. The Support Team is wonderful, caring and empathetic! Love them! I have never bought in app purchases in games before but slowly started in this game since it was really helping me.  Aside from the game you are able to trade cards from the card albums with other players and I have had interactions with players in many foreign countries, now with a pen pal friendship with a player in Belize…I am in the USA.  Anxiety is now a way of life in my country and so I find great escape and comfort playing Travel Town and look forward to playing every day. I am told some folks only use the free energy you can get to play but that has not been my experience. I justified my spending as it was good for my health and cheaper than more therapy…but I have spent so much now it is really embarrassing and not sustainable on my income! I wish the game was more affordable to play long term. It has been great but expensive!

author: hdkdjfjejsjs
title: Good, but it could be much better
content: Let me start off by saying i’m in level 38, so I’ve clearly been hooked to this game for a while now. That being said, the longer I play it, the less I want to. As you go up the levels, the “stacks” no longer give you enough items to keep merging; you have to tap a million times to get the things you need to win money or building materials. Like the pottery, for example- you wouldn’t believe how much I hate that thing. Waste of time. The daily challenges are quite literally impossible to finish unless you spend the 24 hours of the day playing, which is obviously ridiculous and even then I doubt you’ll finish. The stacks that require you no energy to use are annoying because the things come out on their own if there’s nothing around it. Which honestly I doubt it’ll be anyone’s case because they give you basically no room to store the stacks or items you no longer need (mind you, the stacks you started the game with are not useful at all whatsoever past level 10, if I could sell them I would). So yeah, with no energy (because it takes like 3 business days to get it), no room on the board to keep merging, no place to put things away, and having to click a stack 6 times to give you an item you don’t even need and pray you’ll eventually get those you do need to keep merging, i doubt i’ll keep playing the game much longer. A shame, because I actually enjoy it. But it’s more annoying the more you play it. Definitely could use more work and some fixes if you want to keep it engaging.

author: masters level student
title: I want to play longer…
content: I am at a point where I am almost stuck, it takes several days to complete orders because it takes so much energy to build up the items needed for the orders. Energy is used up quickly and regenerates 1 every 2min (slow). I can quickly use up all 100 energy in 2 minutes…Space on the merge board gets tight, which I can respect and that doesn’t really bother me. I don’t want a game that is completely easy. But I wish I could store away all or more of my buckets into the bucket inventory tab. For some reason I can only store the beach bucket and see no way of opening up the other bucket slots. I also wish I could earn more gems (without paying) so I could at least slowly expand my item inventory tab as well. But I quickly spend all my gems on more energy because that’s the only way you can play longer than a minute at a time. I like the storyline and enjoyed the Halloween theme “mini game”. I didn’t understand why there was a very short “Day of the Dead” challenge mini game in the mix with the main merge game but we also lost power/internet for 2 days so maybe I would have enjoyed or understood it more if I could have played during that time. I also went back to look at the updates being done because the game developers frequently respond to reviews saying they are taking recommendations into account. However, the game update reports don’t give any information. Several of us give the same suggestions but updates don’t report the changes being made and major changes don’t seem to be happening very often.

author: hashtag-anthems
title: Pretty good game, though the ads are misleading.
content:
I got this game because the ads made it look more like a coffee shop themed merge game, which sounded fun. I got to the app page and was disappointed to see it wasn’t, but I thought I would give it a chance anyway since the ad was at least somewhat indicative of gameplay and not a bad soap opera plot showing fake gameplay like some other games I could mention…

I really like it! It’s a good game, prices for things that cost gems are reasonable, recharge times are consistent and short enough that I actually want to come back and play throughout the day unlike some other games that take so long I end up playing once a day if that. The art style for the characters isn’t my personal cup of tea, but the rest of the game is really pretty and I like the icons for all the items on my board.

My main complaint is that I only ever have three requests at a time, usually only one of which gives smilies, and two of them have items in them that I can’t make currently and have no idea how to create. Having more requests at a time (maybe scaled with level? I’m at level 23 currently and only progressing with the “hidden” requests of three big sandcastles or cutlery sets that only appear when the needed items are on the board) would be helpful. Also, showing what item produces the target item when you select an item’s info page instead of just showing the merge chain would be helpful. I have no idea how to make soap or tea cups, and two of my three requests need those, so I’m essentially down to one request at a time.

author: FnMnLn
title: Minor issues (Sorry if I complain too much)
content:
Travel Town is a great game, but it also really needs money. I can’t spend, but it needs so much money if you want to play for a long time with out stopping. I love it, but I often have to leave for a couple hours to wait for energy. I was crazy enough to calculate the time I needed to wait for a 100. 3 hours and 20 minutes. So, by that logic, if I run out at, say, 10:43,  I have to wait in till 2:03. And if this is at P.M, I waiting in till 2:00 IN THE MORNING. I NEED SLEEP, BUT I’M ADDICTED. So this is likely a me problem, but I do want more energy after the 3 hours 20 minutes than 100. Again, it was probably a me problem. But the game itself is partially the reason, for being so appealing. Another issue is that I’m struggling to get even the easy orders done without extra energy. I know the orders are getting harder, but the point of the easy orders in my opinion is to allow you to finish an order with minimal amount of energy. I would also like for the surprise boxes to automatically pause when you exit the app. I know this would allow you to get more prizes, but they aren’t even given out that often, free or prize. 
Sorry this is so long! But it is a good game, and it’s still fine with or without these. Do what you want!

author: Guy 1139*
title: Boring
content:
This game was fun at first, but as you het higher in level the things needed to advance get more and more complicated to get. This might sound great. Like it’s better because it’s more challenging, but no, it isn’t more challenging. It just takes longer doing the exact same thing you were doing at the lower level. 
In game you use various generators to make different lines of products. Each generator seems to prefer one of their components more than others, so if I need soup and to merge the soup to higher levels, I might waste all of my energy making fruit salad and never even make one pre soup component. The game also retires these generators at various levels, so you may have spent 3 days leveling up that soup and now there are no more foods needed in the game at all. 
The absolute worst part of the game is opening it. You cannot start playing without at least 2, maybe up to 6 pop up windows advertising events and special items and sales that they are having. 
Another dumb feature is that the generators need to recharge when you over use them. They only recharge when you do the overuse though e.g. I use the soup generator 38 times then do other stuff or wait for more energy to regenerate. You would think after 4 hours the generator would be back to normal, unfortunately after 2 more clicks you have to wait for it to recharge. (Hypothetical numbers) Why won’t it refresh while it is sitting idle for 4 hours. Terrible.

author: Abby Lu 333
title: The more you buy the less you win and the more you struggle
content: I enjoyed playing the game but more and more they make the items less attainable. You get tons of items you don’t need to get a few you do. The rewards for upgrading and advancing level will never be enough to even begin to compensate the investment of time and money, yes, money. The worst happened today after they upgraded the app yesterday, while being at level 23 and having upgraded many times, and having just bought coins and diamonds, I am now getting items at ground level from before I upgraded. Example, I was getting a glass of soda to start with and it would go up from there, now the game it’s starting me lower, at a glass of water so I need to merge many more times to get to the item I want and this is happening with all of my other items??!!!! What???!! Is this the reward for upgrading and spending my money??  Mind you I usually just play but I decided to put some money to see how it would reward me for it, if at some point it just allows you to build and then I could keep playing with what was built, the answer is no. Even if you make plenty of coins, you can’t buy power nor diamonds with it. You can only upgrade a town that you get  basically almost nothing back for your upgrade. content:

author: Starseed007
title: Fun game, but
content:

If I could, I would play for hours, but sadly, 100 energy points only lasts me about three minutes of play. Then I watch the ads to get the extra 25 points. title: One of the best games I’ve ever played!
content: I discovered this game because it was apart of a offers page. I wanted to get this SHEIN $750 dollar reward card. But it told me I had to complete 12 offers before I could get it. This was one of the games I downloaded it told me I had to reach level 7. It’s almost level 12 and honestly I was hooked the first 5 minutes of playing! It was quite funny because I didn’t care anymore about that offers page. I had found a one of the most fun games ever and that’s what I was happy about. You can play this game for hours and be entertained. You will be upset when your energy runs out. But you can watch a few ads to gain more energy. It’s kinda of a good thing for you to take a break and let the energy build up again. You can buy more energy but it’s really not necessary. So this game so so fun. I could play it for hours. I highly recommend it. I even shared on my Facebook. It’s rare for me to share games like that but I was like this game is real special. So yes this is the type of game you will wanna keep playing again and again.

author: Oxiqueen84
title: Honest review
content: Going to give an honest review, in the beginning it’s fun. They give you lots of lighting aka energy bolts that you need apparently to match things and create things. But after level 20, forget it. It’s not that it becomes difficult. It becomes extremely difficult to play if you do NOT pay. Yes, that’s correct what I’ve stated. If you’re not putting money into this, then it becomes absolutely unplayable. You only get 100 bolts, every two minutes you get another one, but after it goes to 100 that’s it you’re done. To create something on level 20 now you need to match things and merge things about seven 7-25 times. Every time you pull out an item so you can merge, you use one bolt. So for example, if you need to make a bowl of ice cream, there are 7 dishes prior you have to create to get ice cream. 2 yogurts create sweet coffee, then you need 2 more yogurts to create another copy so that way you can merge the two coffees together. Every time you take one yogurt out or whatever is that you’re making it’s taking a bolt. So by the time you’re done, you’ve already wasted all your bolts and you have not finished creating your meal. Hence why you need to buy with real cash those bolts oh wait for about an hour for you to get more bolts. It’s insane and ridiculous. It defeats the l purpose of you actually trying to play freely. There will be little game courses you can play to get more bolts for free, but once again it’s making me meals and like 30 minutes so you still have to spend money to get more bolts. I did not buy any so I’m telling you right now. This game is not playable after a certain level which is level 20.

author: Awesome!...no not really
title: Very cheaty
content:
Update: developers do not listen to their players! It should not take 2 minutes to gain energy! This is ridiculous and a waste of time. It is a pay to play game 100%. There is absolutely no way to gain energy unless you’re paying real money. I’m deleting and never downloading again. 

This game was fun the first three levels and then turned very cheaty very fast. It never gives you what you need. It takes forever to build up energy. There is absolutely zero way to earn energy unless you spend diamonds or real money. You can’t upgrade buildings without building material but you can’t get the material because you can’t get the items or even move the customers around. I’ve had the game for 2 days and it’s absolutely annoying that you can’t get anywhere in this game unless you spend money! Have you seen this economy??? No one is willing to spend their hard earn income on a game. Now if you gave us more ways to earn energy or did it like some other games where you can give others energy it would be great! Also why do you need WiFi with this game?? The only reason I gave 2 stars is because there are no adds. So thank you for that. But this game needs serious work with the players in mind. You could always go look at Royal match or Lilly’s garden for ways to improve the game. Thanks for reading.

author: pro soligolfer
title: Blue Gems!
content:
Hello developers. Getting straight to the point. Either the recharge time needs to be lowered or give more opportunities to gain blue gems to buy energy. The shop is useless to me because i never have blue gems to spend. Why cant things in the shop be bought with smileys instead? Certain orders take entirely too long to fulfill. This drives you to have to try to merge other items in the meantime which quickly fills the board with items you cant sell because theyre needed. With each source at least give enough items to make half the order. Also when leveling up the energy level should rise. 100 is not alot of energy when your whole top row is a source object. The seashells and silverware takes forever! 
In closing, dont take this as a negative review. Love the game and latest update. Not asking for a simplified game but more of a balance. I play daily every chance i get. But make it worth my effort  . I shouldnt be merging for weeks to get one high level food item.  Its pointless to use the whole 100 energy to try and get one high leveled food item thats still not completed after using the next 100 after waiting on a recharge.  Work with me please. Im level 24 and only have 4 areas unlocked. Come on!

author: Scorpiosokas
title: Unbelievable
content:
I wanted to thank you guys for making this game progressively stingier and stingier to the point where first, I just refused to spend money on principle, and now it’s gotten SO bad and I have been so wildly insulted and infuriated that I literally finally dropped even the free version. I just got 2 max items that I spent weeks building to and my prize was a few thousand coins and TWENTY TWO ENERGY. TWENTY TWO LOL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! YOU USE 22 ENERGY IN 4 SECONDS. THAT IS MY PRIZE FOR WEEKS OF BUILDING TO A MAX ITEM - TWO OF THEM. the slap in the face for those of us who have spent money on this game thinking eventually you’d get some level of rewards or something for shelling out our money on this tr ash, but NOPE! the game has just gotten even worse and made sure you have to pay the equivalent of a second rent to be able to play it regularly. I have no idea how this game isn’t somehow qualified a s a s c a m for how much money they take and give you progressively less and less. 

let me be clear people - you can spend the amount of money to buy every single gaming console available (PS5, xBox, Wii, Switch, etc) on this piddly little app and you will not get one single molecule of rewards/levelling/ANYTHING to show for it. 

DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!!!!!! this sort of pay to play game is worse than gambling bc you literally get ZERO return on they money you put down. ZERO.

author: App user30
title: Unrealistic expectations lead to desperation for money.
content: The game is fun and entertaining. Cute graphics and it is enjoyable to play. However despite its temptation to lure you in, it’s all ruined. Sure you can progress. But there’s little point or drive to go forward, you HAVE objectives but they are unrealistic to hit. Even the daily’s goals are unrealistic to hit, the first 5 are realistic then they want you to get 20k in 24 hours. If you live on the game and constantly play so your energy is never fully recharged and you use it every time you are active, you will get about an average of 8k gold. That’s the maximum that’s realistically obtainable if you do nothing else all day long. (That’s called an unhealthy addiction btw and no one should be expected to play your game like that.) so how can you get 20k for the daily? You can’t! The only thing I can think of is the devs want you to spend money, lots of it! Just to get the daily! I didn’t do the stupid amount of math to calculate how much money you’d have to spend to reach the daily, every day, but it’s a lot. You can’t even get bats to open your pumpkins without completing the daily. Honestly it’s so unrealistic, I’d write this game off as a really well done scam. I give money to games. But I won’t be giving money to this game. So the devs know, you get more money by being less greedy, then you do trying to force your players to spend. Games that only ask for money through cosmetics, get record breaking purchases. Just keep that in mind. Key example is once human. The game is mediocre but fun. But it’s pretty and they only sell cosmetics. They are getting stupid amounts of money for a game that needs lots of work.

author: GinkoBee
title: Great game - has flaws.
content:
I would literally play this game all day long if it wasn't for the ridiculously fast rate at which you run out of energy and then everything is behind a pay wall or ads. I don't mind watching the ads but after 3, the option disappears and you're left with spending real money as your only option. For now, I'm game to wait until my energy refills and come back to play again but I keep wondering how long before I get annoyed enough to stop. I've spent some real money on the game but overall really try to avoid doing that so I feel I'll be done with it sooner than later.

I agree with some of the other reviews that talk about how difficult it becomes to make higher level items once you reach a certain level and how maxed out creator items rarely give you what you actually need. These two things lead to a very crowded and overwhelming board which makes it a little less fun and more anxiety-producing. 

I think it's a great game and is definitely super fun and addicting but just wish I could play longer without running out of energy and/or having to spend actual money to play for more than 5min.

author: Rashawnda
title: Money Racket
content: This game is a complete money racket! You can try for an entire month to collect enough cards in order to win prizes, and instead of actually awarding those cards to you, they will give you multiples of the same card so it becomes impossible for you to get the compete set!  And every time you pay for an upgrade or pay for extras, you can guarantee they will just give you replacements of the same items you already have. Also, I counted that it took over 250 energy bolts just to keep rolling the dice until you get an item that will award you coins or other freebies. For example, the boat icon pumps out like five different items. So if you get some thing that requires 10th in line of said item, you will be playing forever and spending lots of money just to roll the dice and attempt to get that item. With you only getting 100 bolts a day for free, it is COMPLETELY not worth it, especially considering the fact that most games reward you for playing with freebies more frequently. Nothing on this site is free. You have to pay for every last item that you get and the new update is horrible. Take my word for it, play another merge game. There are many that aren’t scams! I could own Xbox in the amount of dollars I’ve had to spend just to get to a basic level. Deleting as we speak.

author: p.maybs
title: Great game but that update though
content: This is my favorite game. I pretty regularly come back about every three hours - after my energy had replenished sometimes sooner with the auto producers. I have even spent some of my own money on it. This new update though. I am so disappointed. A lot of the previous producers that I had competed are no longer completed and as I am completing them…again it’s not for any new content. It’s for an item that I had previously achieved but the makeup of the producer has changed so it nullifies my progress. I just feel jipped and it’s annoying to go back to complete something that I’ve already completed. Also now when you reach the max level - it no longer gives an option for an auto buy. I really loved that and it helped clear off my board. An idea for the developers - give an option for orders to decline like 3 in a day and then any more declined would require a gem purchase. Also I would like the trading group to be in app. I still enjoy the game and will keep playing but I am much less motivated to log on and I am still disappointed and will continue to be bummed out until I have finally backtracked and made progress that I already did.

author: shaynayner
title: I used to love this game
content:
I used to really enjoy this game. Then the daily challenges became unattainable unless you play the game alllllllllll day or pay loads of money to continue adding energy. I don’t even want to play it anymore. The goals are just too hard and I liked that I could still make the goal and get my orders done casually throughout the day. Now I can’t even do one. Why should I even bother playing if there is no reward?
Also, the fossil that you get an order for at the beginning is also unattainable. I’ve done everything I can to look for it and still nothing. I am on level 27 and got the order for the fossil on level 1 or 2. I also can’t find any more maps to continue merging my treasure maps. I haven’t seen a treasure map since like level 10 or 11, so they are just taking up space that I don’t have. 
AND you merge the suppliers that spit items out which should give you higher leveled items more frequently, but 99% of the items that come out are level 1 items, even though the supplier is at max level. So again, what is even the point if it is this hard and no reward?
I tried it, I loved it. They changed the game and I gave it a shot, but I don’t enjoy it anymore. It feels more like a chore now so I will be deleting it.

author: Lo2715
title: Fun but EXPENSIVE and RIGGED >:(
content: PLEASE READ: save yourself a lot of time and money. The game is enjoyable to an extent. I’m embarrassed to say I have spent well over $300 on TT (which I NEVER do for an app). But I couldn’t advance unless I bought a package and now I'm starting to realize it’s a waste. One item needed for orders takes all of my energy, items keep disappearing, including diamonds. But what really annoys me is the card packs. And this is the honest truth…. I opened 20+ packs in a row and they were all dupes except for one…ONE!!!! Even XL & SUPER packs. I wish I could show screenshots here bc I’ve been documenting everything ever since I noticed the unfairness of this game. It’s a huge let down esp considering the amount of money I’ve put into it.  Don’t think I’ll be playing much longer. ON A BETTER NOTE….I came to realize there are much cheaper merge games out there. Better story lines, cheaper packages, all under $10. It’s more fun playing an affordable game, where you can advance fairly. Travel Town is basically a money pit. The developers seem greedy. $30 for a package that gets sucked up making just a couple items and card packs that only release one every so often is a huge disadvantage. Do better.

author: Aafangel06
title: Love it but also don’t…
content: I love the story line and all of the different generators - it’s less boring because of that. I also really like that you can store some of your lesser used generators so they don’t take up space, and that the building supplies don’t cost energy to free them from the tool boxes. However, for many of the generators you get maybe one special item for every maybe 15-20 regular items, so when a customer asks for higher level special item, it takes many cycles of energy to get it. It’s probably quite literally impossible to complete all daily tasks without spending gems and/or real money. Opportunities to collect gems are sparse. Finally, customers rarely, if ever ask for lesser-valued items once you have a given generator more developed/completed. Except for newly discovered generators, the customers only ask for high level items. Ultimately it is the energy expense of order fulfillment that will cause me to delete this game, I just haven’t…yet. I understand that these developers need the players to spend real money in order for the developers to make money, but when they make it this much of a hassle to progress that I delete the game, what did they really gain?

author: Mr Kachow
title: Fun game, some issues
content: It’s a fun game, but my only few issues with it are that there are way too many pop-ups when trying to play the game. When I open the app there’s an absurd number of pop-ups for different events, things to spend real life money on, etc. and it takes too long to get past them all to play the actual game. If you run out of energy it gives you four pop-up windows trying to get you to buy more energy points. The worst one is when it directs you to open the pass and you actually have to click “activate” before it gives you a red X to click out of it. That’s an active effort to try to force me to pay for the pass and I don’t want the pass. I’d like if there were fewer pop-ups or if there was a setting to just turn them off. Or they could all pop up at once as a thing you can scroll through, so you can see them all but it’s not taking forever to show me new things back to back, you know what I mean? Other than that I think it’s great. I love this game.

author: sirias13
title: Bubbles - Energy
content:
I think this is a very nice game. I enjoy quite a bit everything this far. As of right now I only have 2 gripes. 1. when you run out of energy it costs you 10 gems to refill, the issue is that gems are hard to get (I understand that the company have to make money by selling packages, but allow the opportunity to earn more gems a bit more quickly). Also, why don’t you start small with how much gems energy costs, say instead of starting at 10 gems start at 5 and do increments of 5 thereafter, that would be more reasonable and will allow the opportunity to buy packages. 2. thereafter bubbles when you either combine 2 items or get it while pumping an item are fine, what is annoying is the fact that you either watch a video to get the item or pay with gems, either I have no problem, but if I don’t need that bubble item I have to wait 2-3 minutes for the bubble to pop, meanwhile that bubble is taking space that I need. If you can have the option to just pop the bubble and get the one coin or one gem you give that would be awesome.
Otherwise, very entertaining game!

author: Eraste
title: Too many generators
content:
Minor update: to give credit where it’s due, a lot of people were talking about how the generators were clogging up our inventory, and they went and added in a special generator inventory which freed up a lot of space. So, great move. Still weird they have so many (and don’t even use all of the parts within them - unless we revisit them way later) but, hey, small victories

They keep adding new ones and you have to store away the old ones. And there is no way to get inventory slots with the basic currency like in EVERY OTHER GAME OF THIS TYPE. It’s still a good merge game though. However, these few things will keep it from being better than some of the others in the genre. But yea, someone else mentioned either adding a generator tab for storage, or, you know… stop adding a million generators/have future orders use the old generators. Of course, I’m sure it’s like this to con you into spending more money to add storage slots. I won’t fall for that, but I will keep playing until it becomes too much of a hassle (at this time I’m level 63 and it’s still manageable). Updated from 3 to 2 after multiple changes to make playing free even less friendly.

author: Melavista
title: I’m done
content: Update: I was trying to give the benefit of the doubt, but I can’t waste my time anymore. I can’t get the items I need to level up and the rest of the time it takes me forever to get the items to get tool chests. This isn’t fun anymore it’s become like a job. Thanks for the pointless updates that don’t help. The other day I finally complete a task that gave me 6 large toolboxes….I still wasn’t able to update any of the 5 outstanding buildings I have. I’m done. I loved this game. However I don’t think I can continue. I play the challenges to get toolboxes and meet the daily goal every day. Yet I still don’t get the parts I need to level up. The algorithm is not fair based on the needs you have. I have a million brick walls and yet zero wallpapers. This needs a better update and with all the tasks I complete I should have another option of leveling up. It’s frustrating to work towards so,etching for so long just to be disappointed. What is the point of an update with new buildings if I can’t even get to the buildings I have!! Also completely blocked from leveling up. I was a beta user and in half the time was a higher level than I am now after the reset. The tool boxes are way too random and don’t give what I need. I’ve been waiting on a plug for at least a month. I’m over this.

author: ConsciousCora
title: Frustrating
content: This game would be so fun if it weren’t pretty much impossible to fill orders without spending actual real money. Their algorithm seems to be set to give you the items you don’t need when trying to fill an order. At first I thought this was just in my head but it keeps happening so that I use all of my energy and I have filled my board with items I don’t need. Then, when I delete some of those items to make space on my board, suddenly I get a customer that is ordering the very things I deleted. It is incredibly frustrating. The events are impossible to complete and can be somewhat confusing. They make it so you get super close to winning the event but in the end you either end up paying money to get more energy or you lose the event. Some people still lose after purchasing. Don’t even get me started on the cards. I will get lots of cards on any given day, none of which will be what I need to complete sets and win prizes. I will sit with being one away from completing a set on like 3 or 4 sets, get 10 cards and they’re all cards I already have. This game is impossible. Beautiful, vibrant graphics though. Takes too much of my time for me to never win anything. Will probably end up deleting it along with so many other players on this game.

author: MaccaJude
title: Started out fun
content:
This game started out fun but now is to the point where it’s repetitive, especially if you don’t want to spend money on it. I have 10 “producers” in storage because I’m never asked to use them for orders or anything. What’s the point of having so many producers if half of them never get used? I’m also about to delete the entire app because of the pop-ups every time I open it. There is no reason for 5-6 pop-ups, and I really don’t appreciate being forced to agree to participate in special events in order to get the pop-up to go away.

Editing to add I am deleting this game and you’ve lost the money I was spending on it. I’m tired of having to click through eight different pop ups just for the privilege of be of allowed to sign I’m, and I’m tired of being forced to participate in your special events. I support your business by actually making purchases in the game and I should have the right to pass on “Fireworks Frenzy” or whatever it’s called. You have lot of nerve monetizing this game and then also controlling what people do and decline to do in it. Good luck finding replacements for the users you lose by being annoying and greedy.

author: IceColdnSunny
title: Disappointing, don’t bother
content:
TLDR: Fun and addictive, they did well. But don’t bother, you can’t play and achieve things in a reasonable amount of time without spending money. That, coupled with the prices of the packages, makes it absolutely ridiculous to continue to support the game. 

You could play for free, like many people do, and just achieve things over days or weeks or not at all… or you can pay $30+ like some people do, and achieve things over days or weeks or not at all… 🤷🏿‍♀️ or, finally, you can come to your senses and realize there are apps out there that want your money AND want you to enjoy and continue to play. I DELETED THE APP! Yesterday, I bought 4,000 energy and was only able to complete 10 of the 20+ daily tasks. YES, 4,000 energy spent to only achieve HALF the daily tasks. Lmbo… I provided feedback a while ago about the cost to complete basic things. That was the final straw for me. And to the developers, you could respond with your usual, ‘we’re sorry for your bad experience and we’ll take your feedback into consideration when making improvements,’ but what if you actually improved our experience?? What if you made appropriate changes that enhanced UX and turned these 1 star reviews into 5 star reviews, and significantly reduced churn?? Just a thought.

author: hotelier3400
title: Overall great!
content:
I really like this game. It is simple and fun. There are natural slow-down mechanisms designed to get you to spend money, but they aren’t very bad and don’t interrupt the game in a way that detracts from it, in my opinion. 

However, I can’t give it five stars due to a specific problem. At the top of the game there are 4-5 community members with orders you need to fulfill. These orders tend to be the most important way of moving forward / making progress in the town. But early on one of the orders is for a fossil. And this fossil is basically impossible to get! And there is no way to dismiss / move on from that order. So I’m basically down to 3 orders for the rest of the game instead of 4. I did write to the app developer about the fossil, and they impressively responded rather quickly. But the way they said to try to get it is ineffective (I’ve clicked the relevant thing 500 times, so I did give it a chance) and for some reason the joker (which is supposed to merge with *anything*) won’t merge here either. 

So: overall very happy with the game. Don’t like this one thing that is detracting from my experience.

author: average potater
title: Has potential...
content:
I, like many others, had my progress reset with The Update. I thought it was fun at first, there were new resources to get, and it was much easier to get the higher level item spawners compared to before. The idea of having building materials was also interesting. 

However, they completely nerfed the drop rate of higher level items from the spawners. For example, previously, at a level 7-8 sand bucket, you could occasionally spawn max level sand castles and starfish. Now, you can only spawn level 3 castles and shells, max. Same with the picnic basket, and I imagine every other spawner. The devs claim that this new update will smooth the progression, so you don't have to be stuck on a level for days. That's not the case. Orders are MUCH higher level, asking for items at the end of the merge chain, and you have to spend days grinding for orders and building supplies. Do I think this is a ploy to get players to spend more money? Probably. Bad move, devs. 

I want to give them the benefit of the doubt, so I'll keep the game until the next update comes out. Maybe this new version just needs to be balanced better. I think the devs should've just made a sequel, tbh, instead of resetting long-time players.

author: AylondraM
title: Unfair Moderators in Trade Group
content: I LOVE this game. It helps me pass the time during my chemotherapy treatments and long drives to appointments. I used to have no issues with the trading group page on FB until I put up a post stating I can donate some cards. Apparently FB doesn’t like the words “donations” and they told me this so I fixed it but then it was never posted a flyer being fixed. Now a few weeks have passed and every day I put up a post to trade and it won’t be posted till 6-8 hours after. I brought this up to them and was told that it was because the moderators have a lot of posts to go through. I get that. BUT my posts did not take this like before as well as the fact that I’m pretty certain that NO ONE is waiting 6-8 hours for their trade post to be posted. This may not seem like a big deal but trading cards is one of the bases of the game. With my post going up at 12-1am in the morning, I am being hindered of this ability unless I scroll through EVERYONES post to trade every day. I’m pretty close to uninstalling this game mind you I DO put money into it so you’re close to losing business if this doesn’t get addressed and figured out why perfectly fine posts are not being treated fairly

author: ~thenofacedoll~
title: Loved game in the beginning but now not so much
content: I have played this game since July and it’s have been INVESTED mentally and financially. In the beginning it was much easier to complete the tasks and if you wanted to continue playing just to play then you could pay for gems and energy. Now recently I realized that the tasks are now almost unattainable unless you spend money everyday. Which shouldn’t be. The album for example there is no reason that I gave so many multiples of cards over and over again I can’t get to complete the entire album within the time of I am investing my time into the game. Then there are the tasks to get coins to complete challenges there is no reassign it takes 100 energies to come half way to completing one. then the only way is to wait to get energy or watch the adds and you can only do that 4 times in a day so that isn’t even a lot and to get to another 100 it takes almost 3 hours.  It starting to be a turn off. Which makes me sad because i truly enjoyed playing

author: godslittlebee
title: Needs undo button or confirmation button
content: Generally I love this game and have been playing for a long time, have developed my own strategies in how to maximize my energy and time and resources. The one big issue here is that with other merge games, there is a temporary undo option or at least a “did you mean to purchase this”? confirmation check for things that cost a lot of resources, especially with the amount of interaction with the game, it’s very easy to accidentally graze over a button and delete an essential item or buy something you didn’t mean to with coins and or gems you have been saving for something else. And sometimes that is an accidental double click. This is the third time I have went to buy a energy chest for 24 gems and it gave me 2 chests and took 72 gems from me that I have been collecting and working on all month to build up. I did not want that and did not need it and was saving it for other items in the shop that I really need. this can really mess up progress and can be a huge detriment to retaining players for this game.

author: Ashfont
title: Disheartening
content: The original game presented a charming and enjoyable matching experience. However, the recent update has significantly altered the game's mechanics, making the completion of orders and challenges considerably more difficult without incurring real money expenditures. Production orders are now generated irrespective of the producer's retirement status, rendering the retirement storage feature obsolete. Additionally, auto-producers are now rendered ineffective unless they are fully merged. The updated Terms and Conditions stipulate that users are prohibited from exploiting or disclosing exploits within the game. It is unreasonable to hold players accountable and compel them to remain silent regarding functional oversights inherent in the game—responsibility for such issues lies squarely with the developers. This game modification appears to target a minority who enjoyed playing within the bounds of the game's rules, without engaging in cheating or hacking, and in doing so, it unduly penalizes the majority of the player base. This change seems to be driven by a desire to increase profits rather than enhance user experience. I was content to support the game and play it in my own manner; however, attributing fault to players for exploiting a loophole that is both technically and legally permissible is profoundly disheartening.

author: AmandaThePotato
title: Almost Perfect
content:
This game is great. Other merge games I've tried are either too slow, or impossible to play without spending money. There's obviously effort being put into this game, it's not something made for a quick buck. There's no interruption ads, though there are many popup prompts for purchases. The pace you can move at isn't too fast or slow. I've had the game for about 3 weeks and I'm on level 28. 

My main problem with this game, is the energy system. I know there's meant to be some idle features on this game, but this is too much. It takes almost 4 hours to get full energy. I feel like I never actually get to play the game because I'm constantly waiting for the game to let me play. And there's hardly any others ways to get it without spending money. $4 for only 200 energy? That's not worth it at all. I wish there was a way to eliminate the energy feature, so I can actually play the game for more than 3 minutes at a time. I'd be willing to pay for that, it would be like playing a full version of the game. I just wish there was less waiting for the game and more actually ppaying the game.

author: Goddessmint1
title: Was great until…
content: I spent a pretty penny on this game ($200+ USD.) What I noticed is that the daily challenges for events give you either a 3 star or 4 star card pack, which usually won’t give any new cards after the 5th one you open. The chest only containing 2 star or 3 star card packs isn’t beneficial for progression in the events. Having several duplicates is irritating, especially since I can only give out 2 per day, and by the time I finish with the daily tasks I have already gotten 2+ duplicates. You can’t usually get golden cards, and having to pay for packs just to get a chance at getting them is annoying. Not being able to trade them is even more so, as I have gotten duplicates of the golden cards. Making card packs more expensive has turned me off on purchasing any. It has gotten harder to progress in the game itself as everything takes longer to complete. The coins is not the issue, but rather the toolbox. In the beginning, you could get 2-3 toolboxes, however now it’s only 1-2. If it takes more energy to complete, I think it should give more (ie 4-5 toolboxes). I’m hoping that the next update will bring some big improvements.

author: 1at
title: Great game!
content:
I started playing this game because it was the only one I have found that is anything like Merge Mansion, but it has turned out to be much better, and the storyline is actually interesting in this one (a little weak, but still interesting).

I honestly don’t understand why some reviewers are complaining that it is a money grab and impossible to play after a few levels or so.  I am level 34 and have not been stuck unable to advance anywhere and I have not had to spend a dime.  
The only issue is the fossil quest - I eventually gave up on it and googled it, and found out that it drops from the lower level beach bucket.  As your beach bucket gets to be higher levels, the chance of it dropping go down drastically.  So it took a very long time to get it from my maxed bucket - be sure to get it before you level the beach bucket.  Otherwise it is a great game that I have as much fun with now as I did 34 levels ago, and I will probably be still be playing it for a lot longer.

author: PChu4
title: Should be ZERO stars now
content:
TLDR - since the game ran an update, it is impossible to reach the daily/weekly goals without spending money a significant amount of money. Find a different game. NOT WORTH YOUR TIME OR MONEY. 
I started playing this game early 2025. I REALLY enjoyed it and looked forward to the daily goals and special challenges. I joined the FB group & Subreddit to learn the game better & learned some ways to earn more energy and keep playing longer without spending too much. I normally do not spend money on any games but I would drop a few dollars each week to meet a special daily goal for a better prize.  In July i had surgery and while recovering I actually spent $50, I felt a little bad/stupid but really enjoyed the game and looked at it as an entertainment expense. 
The game recently updated and now I can’t meet a daily/weekly goal without spending money, I caved in today and spent money and still didn’t reach the level I needed for the prize. 
The update has taken all the fun out of the game, it is just a money grab from the company. Good news for me, I’m not spending money and am spending less and less time each day on the game. 
I see myself deleting the game soon and honestly will miss the aspects of the original game.

author: Skeeder7722
title: Great overall
content: This game has quickly become my favorite one to play. However, there are a few things that have been bothering me. It is obvious that you save up coins in order to upgrade buildings, which get more expensive the further you get into the game. There have now been TWO instances where I have spent 5,000 coins to buy a new building but there is nothing there and says “upgrades coming soon”. I’m sorry but if it isn’t ready to be played, don’t give the option to buy the building. 5000 coins is a lot and could’ve gone to one of my other buildings and actually progressed it, instead I am out the coins and can’t do anything to further my level without waiting 2-3 days to get that amount of coins back. It really is frustrating and is something that should be taken into account. Like I said, this has become one of my favorite games as it is satisfying and fun to merge items and create new ones, along with excelling your town. These are just a few things that should be thought through for the players sake.

author: I wish to punch this app
title: Do not play
content: Screw this game! You know there isn’t even a history for the trading group? So people get to lies and not hold up their end of the deal! It’s absolutely ridiculous! I have been playing this game for about 3 to 4 months and honestly everything was great until they introduced card trading which is done through Facebook so my Facebook account got hacked three separate times trying to trade cards with people in order to complete things. Ultimately, they should’ve just made an engraving trading option, even a battle option where we could mix-and-match to see who can clear a random board faster or get more points. I really hope that somebody in the game development sees my review and makes the changes to get away from having Facebook friends to trade with. It’s fine it’s decently paste. If you get impatient, you will spend money on the game. Most of the offers are pretty good less than five dollars and get you a good hour or two of gameplay. My other suggestion is to allow the idle gaining of the energy to go beyond 100. I feel like when somebody wakes up in the morning if they had 3 to 400 energy they might be more compelled to play during the day and this would probably increase their profits.

author: Sacharles2323
title: Needs major changes and update is more expensive - bring back bubbles turning to energy
content:
The newer update made it much harder to get energy. Before the extra drops were bubbles that turned into energy when unpopped,  now they are coin. I have over $300k in coin but have almost no room on my board, and cannot move forward in the game because I need more energy to merge. At level 136 it takes weeks or months to get enough resources to build and move forward. Changing the way we received energy was a huge mistake, now I am stuck at this level and is no longer fun. I use to pay money for gems when energy was in the bubbles, because it meant I could play awhile. Now I barely play and refuse to spend any money on this game now. I’ve tried a few times since the changes with the bubbles, and not worth. Shame the game had to be so greedy. You went from someone spending money weekly to never again because of your greed. 

Also, all the storage slots are all used by useless generators. So all that time and money spent getting full storage is wasted by 70% of it being occupied by generators I have not been asked to use in months. Ridiculous.

author: Ali4422
title: Addicted! - Update
content:
UPDATE: 

I'm on level 33 and I'm beginning to enjoy the game less. The orders are only for the higher items that take forever to get so I'm constantly out of lives in a matter of minutes and I barely get to fulfill any orders. I ended up having to spend $8 to beat the side quest in time and that's annoying. There are some producers and items that don't even get used anymore which is annoying because they're taking up board space. I don't want to sell the items in case I will need them and I don't have my full storage for producers yet. Not sure how it determines when you get a new space to store a producer? Also, the cost of new storage places for items goes up with each one you get which is ridiculous. I just feel like the game doesn't allow you to ever have enough energy. It caps it at 100 when you're not active (dislike) and it takes soooo much energy when merging to get the higher items. And you only get 1 every 2 minutes!? Come on. So frustrating. I feel like there could be a better balance so the game is still challenging but also still fun to play. 

It's sad because I was seriously loving this game and now I feel like I probably won't be playing for much longer unless the developers make some changes. :( 

ORIGINAL POST:

I don't usually leave reviews, especially for games, but this game is so addicting! I love it. And I love the short little side quests that happen every now and then.

author: Read All the Books!
title: Used to be fun, now it’s a scam
content: When I started playing TT, it was fun. Kind of fed into digital hoarding and hit that feel good for earning achievements. Some strategy went into it, but over all it was mindless and fun. I have spent way too much money and time playing this game and gotten far. I’ve watched many people in various FB groups fall out of love with this game because it takes more and more $ to see real advancement in the game. That bummed me out too but I always believed in spending some in-game money to help support game makers who give me this fun experience. My issue really has come with their latest sets of updates. They keep changing the icons and way producers produce. I spent so much time and energy competing collections but it was for nothing. They updated their producers and took away items in 8 different collections - some that took me months! When I wrote to TT about this, their answer was that those items no longer exist so they can’t return them to me. Gave me 100 energy as compensation… that doesn’t even come close, such an insult. It just makes me not want to play anymore, why should I when all of my progress will be constantly removed for a new “update”. No thank you. Delete.

author: philly_jen
title: Has potential but mostly just frustrating
content:
I enjoyed a lot of aspects of this game, but the ratio of “energy” to items is severely lopsided. You will get maybe a minute or two of free play on a very limited board before waiting 2 minutes for 1 single energy that is used to produce one low level product that comes from a producer item (that also takes up space on the board) that pops out multiple strands of items. So if you’re trying to make a salad, you’ll get sushi and desserts. And then the second you merge up the sushi cause you are out of space, the next thing the game will request is the sushi that you just merged that took 3 days of play just to make…it’s SUPER frustrating. I ended up deleting the game after a week because the rate of play to wait and frustration was not worth it. 

The town that you’re “building” doesn’t progress quickly at all. It will be days before you can do the next step unless you’re spending TONS of money. Most games offer in-app purchases for $1-5 but this wants $7.99 for the opportunity to have another 10 minutes of play…I don’t know who would actually spend money on this thing.

author: Reaghan Hamilton
title: Love the game, hate the pop ups
content: I started playing this because it was a fetch game, so I could get points for leveling up. I kept playing it after my reward opportunities expired because I actually really enjoyed it. I’m level 46, I’ve played pretty consistently for awhile now. The only problem is the insane amount of pop ups. Every time I open the game, there’s like 10-15 events/passes/rewards that it HAS to tell me about. It usually takes over a minute to click through all of the pop ups, which of course isn’t that long, but it happens EVERY time I open the game. Sometimes I’ll finish clicking through all of them, start playing the games, and then get another pop up after like 5 moves as if they were waiting for me to try to play. I actually like some of the mini games/events, but I do not want to click through info about every one every single time I open the game. I frequently choose not to play this game just because I don’t want to deal with the pop ups.  I hate them so much that the entire game is getting 3/5 because they’re so infuriating

author: all4hero
title: Addictive — that’s my issue — the game has plenty of its own
content:
A good game. Fun to play, but gets expensive bc it’s very addictive and you don’t get enough energy to keep playing. Has a few big glitchy issues — items sometimes become invisible but are still there. That’s obviously a big problem. Second, for the past week I’ve had this happen increasingly more often:   the game loads to 36% but stops there. Need to remove game and reinstall! My info repopulates but still… I think it has something to do with Facebook or term agreements. Something that is not connecting properly. Oh! And Facebook connection gets kicked off EVERY time I close the app so I have to reconnect every time I reopen (you get gifts from friends — cards that are part of a collection that when completed give a reward). And this is not bc I’ve reinstalled, I’m talking about the times when it opens normally. So 3 issues, actually, but I’ve kept playing so far….   
You know, it’s such a polished game that I do wonder how this can keep happening. Do they get a kick back every time someone links fb 😆? It’s just weird.

author: Azn Lady Luck
title: The newest update is terrible !
content:
I’ve been playing this game for more than a couple of months and really got hooked to it. I like it so much I actually bought energy & gems for this game. 
I was on Level 51!! I wasn’t even done with all of the unlocking of the buildings. When I updated the newest version June 2021. They put me back to level 1!! Yes you guys gave me a lot of Gems back , but it didn’t last too long & I needed them for energy #newupdate!
Why this update?? so this app update has new and exciting different things?? It’s actually harder to level up now.  Yes you have new things, but in order to build houses you also Now need more “🙂”  smiley faces & supplies in the game verse before where only needed game coins. On top Of that you waste more energy with this new upgrade. So after this I’m on level 17 and I’m struggling, it’s not that fun anymore. Sorry to say I lost interest in this game and now will delete. I’m very disappointed  & sad this game is no longer my favorite. The makers got too carried away in this update making it harder for us “Gamers” . When I mean harder you have to spend more $$ on gems and energy to level up!! It’s not worth it!!
I love Merge games this is app was in my Top 5!! Not anymore!!

author: Mastercarlos19
title: BE WARNED - This game uses predatory monetization
content: I downloaded this game as an advantageous way to earn a promo on another app. Get to level 60. I figured “ I’m gonna play games on my phone regardless, I might as well be productive with it”. The first 25 levels (character level not unique levels you play) were fine, blew threw them like a breeze. Then, it seemed like I was running out of energy and waiting, had just enough dopamine to want to make a micro transaction. It’s a sophisticated level of deceit putting you on the precipice of completing a card catalog, or fulfilling a special order for a HUGE reward but you just need a few more moves! The developers are doing exactly what they intend to, dupe you into making micro transactions. My suggestion would be, shorten the threshold a little bit, because, and I don’t know how much money you’re making off of this, but Toon blast, clash Royale, clash of clans, all survive just fine without this harsh freemium model.

author: switchxxblade
title: Good game but could be better
content: I love this game it’s really addicting the only problem is the amount of energy they give you, or should I say lack there of. I find it that I’m only able to complete one order before my energy runs out and most of the time the reward from said order isn’t even comparable to the energy used to get the item. I don’t want to constantly have to spend gems to get more energy and I’m not putting real money into a free game thus making it not free. I get the point of things being blocked by paywalls, developers gotta make money, but I’m really close to giving up on this game because it’s no longer becoming fun. I don’t even write reviews often but I felt like I should voice my issues. I think that if the devs made some changes with the way energy is given (like instead of one energy every minute it could be shortened to 30 seconds?) I don’t know I just feel like I’m more often waiting for my energy to be restored than actually playing the game which causes me to switch to other games and forget about this one for a bit…

author: shaunadukes
title: Waste of time
content:
Starts off fun, a little confusing about exactly how to create certain items. Further along, it becomes impossible to get the items you need to level up unless you wait hours for your energy to accumulate (1 every 2 minutes??) and then you blow through it and still don’t end up with anything you need. What’s more is I was doing this game through a get-paid-to program and it just wasn’t tracking any of my progress even though I allowed tracking and was hitting the milestones. I filed a ticket with the advertiser, including screen shots to prove when I installed the app and to show what levels I had reached, and they basically said oh that’s too bad, here’s 30 cents for your hours of trouble, there’s nothing else we can do for you. So I deleted the game and will never go back. Don’t waste your time especially if you’re supposed to be compensated for playing.

Edit: the developers replied to my review with a vague response that makes me sound like I don’t know what I’m talking about. I didn’t say the game pays out real money, I said the advertiser that they allow to put their game on a get-paid-to app was essentially useless when my earnings were not tracked.

author: Emi0715!
title: Great game, horrible customer service
content: I love this game but it’s getting to the harder levels and I just like to play to relax so when it gets harder it’s less fun for me. Due to that I figured I’d just restart however to do that I have to delete the account. I sent the request, sent mthe pictures and they tell me it will be done according to the policies and such which is fine. I check two days later and redownload it to see if I can start over but I can’t so I email to get an update and they tell me it will be done according to their policies. I look for the policies and previous emails to see if they gave me a timeframe and they didn’t. I ask for them to clarify or even direct me where I can find the information and they respond by saying it will be done according to their policies. I then ask again trying to clarify my question and same response. I understand things take time, I just wanted a general idea or something but they have given the exact same sentence 3 times in a row as if I’m not talking to a real person and I’m not even asking a difficult question. The lack of care to answer a simple question or  just say I can’t give you a timeframe is just frustrating.

author: Patronakitt
title: Updates= less energy/rewards
content: I used to like this game because it gave you the opportunity of playing a while with the chests and energy it would give you constantly.  It was fun until major updates that happened since 2022 were there’s barely any chests given (unless you pay), barely any energy is given, and NOW in a recent update you can’t even level up and you only give half of the energy (out of 100) you used to give???? Like how do you expect people at higher levels/harder levels (I’m level 56 so I think I have played enough to know) to WANT to play if there’s barely any motivation/rewards/energy you give? Ofc UNLESS YOU PAY..its almost like it’s being forced without telling you to do it. It’s kind of disappointing because I loved this game not bc it was easy but bc the rewards kept me playing…now it’s either I wait hours to play or pay. I don’t know if after this update I want to keep playing. My last straw was this latest update of only getting 50 energy after leveling up. That was the ONLY time you could get a decent chance to keep playing. It should’ve at least stayed the same as before to keep players motivated. Such a disappointment.

author: Daedonlus
title: Addicted
content:
I absolutely love this game! This game is oh so simple, but has the exact right amount of competitive, goal oriented tasks to keep you engaged, and their competitive events are the bomb! It is the perfect game to play while unwinding and watching TV.  I started playing this game as a filler while waiting on my lives to refill on my “real” game. Now this is my real game and I found that their deals on extra energy are not that bad, lol. There are hardly ever any issues and the developers are responsive. I am pretty excited to see what becomes of the new friends feature. Competitive team events 🤔?  My only critique would be that they should they should offer a reward for your duplicate photos to help you complete your albums. Also, maybe acknowledge your anniversary with the game with some type of loyalty reward or select players based on their level of interaction with the game for special offers, or membership deals. Yep, I’m addicted!

L

author: BransonMusician
title: New “update” royally screwed me
content: Very rarely do I spend money on mobile games.. but my wife turned me onto this one, and we play it together. I spent a decent amount of money over the last few months. I’m what the console gaming community refers to as a “completionist”. I like to unlock everything. After all my time playing every single day, I unlocked the second to last sticker on a large set. THOUSANDS of energy used, only to get an update and see that they highly minimized and removed all the things I worked for. I decided go let it go.. until just now. Again, spent HUNDREDS of energy to complete an order that only popped up just yesterday. I was ONE sticker away from completing the order, to get a large coin prize, to unlock another station in town.. logged back in just now, to find that order has disappeared, and I have nothing to use my hard saved items on. I have other orders still hovering up top, that have been there for days and days.. yet the one I was working towards, disappears as soon as I almost complete it? This game is designed for money to be spent.. I get that. But when I DO spend that money, I’d appreciate it at least being fair 😠

author: miss_lshanae
title: Could be better if ….
content:
Love the game. Easy to get addicted too. However, as the levels get bigger more coins are needed to purchase property and it’s harder to fill the customer’s order. The customer will order items that require a lot of energy and only pay 370 coins but you need 12,000 to purchase the next property. It only gives you 100 max energy at a time. So you have to purchase more if you want to keep playing or wait about 200 minutes (3 hours and 20 minutes) to just to get 100 energies. However, any item over level 7 requires more than 126 energies. So you are either waiting or paying for more coins. 

I’ve paid for more coins and you can easily use them quickly if you want to keep playing all day… so before you play consider these things.

Developers, give us more than 100 energies as the levels get higher and stop making it take more than 3 hours to get full energy. It’s annoying and makes me want to stop playing. However, I feel I’ve invested so much money already and I’m only on level 40 😩. A huge rip off .

author: Jezzer2010
title: Good concept, terrible execution
content: Just like the other reviewers experiences, I found this game fun and engaging at first but it quickly gets bogged down with impossible tasks and almost zero direction to progress forward. The game starts well, briskly moving through tasks, but without any direction at all, the board becomes over assorted with items that are useless rendering it impossible to advance. I see reviewers here that are ten to fifteen levels beyond me saying the very same thing, so obviously this is a persistent theme no matter your level of experience. Those reviewers are hardier than myself. I won’t be playing that long to find out I don’t like the game, I already know. The way items are produced, stopping just one item short of what you need to complete a task, is a clear effort to force the players hand into making in app purchases. This leads me to believe the developers main intention was not to make a game so engaging you’d want to spend money to enhance your experience, but rather a pretty brazen money grab before the player realizes the game isn’t worth their time, much less their money. Pretty graphics and greed don’t make a fun game. It all seems rather sloppy to me.

author: Pokervixen
title: Not player friendly
content:
I’ve played this game from the beginning. It has interesting characters and a neat town story. But it has progressively gotten to be a source of frustration instead of a fun distraction. Daily challenges are unachievable using the meager energy they give you and they’re stingy with diamonds, coins and opportunities to get free energy. 
Then they added collections of stickers. They suggest you trade but you have to have Facebook to be in a group to try get trades and then you gift the item and hope the other person does too. It should be set up as an exchange and you should be able to negotiate within the game itself. 
If that’s not hard enough, you can only do two per day and you can’t trade gold cards. 
They started a new collection with all those restrictions but are running it for a month less. 
It’s not fun to play if you never have a chance to win or progress. Expecting us to pay to be successful is gross and has me looking at other games. I used to really enjoy playing this game but I won’t miss the greediness it’s become.

author: Crystalcraig1112
title: Impossible.
content:
Fun game sure but this game is impossible to get anywhere without spending money. So just know that before you download and start playing. The 100 regenerating moves do not increase (not that I’ve found) as you advance. Most games I’ve played your moves or lives etc, increase as you advance. Not this one. Even if you spend money, you can not complete your daily challenges or orders at a decent pace. I’ve seen player’s messages where they’ve contacted the developers about this and they send a big long message but first thing mentioned, is BUYING stuff. A for effort but F for execution. ** I came back to my review after reading other reviews and it seems, we all have the same complaints. Maybe some things to consider @ the developers. :)
Ps.. let’s not even get started on the “new look.” The stationary has all completely changed and new things are added. All of that would not have been so bad if, it was done before I got to it. I was used to merging books and pens and now we have castles and dragons and desk. Just weird and I’ve heard that was done to multiple producers. Annoying.

author: Mkstein
title: Made for suckers
content: Bravo Travel Town. I’ve never played a game that has sucked me in so much that I actually fell for buying bonus packs. Every time I did, I thought to myself, “You are an idiot!” And that is exactly who this game is made for. Suckers. It’s addicting and just when you are sucked into the depths of the game, you run out of energy and need more, so you buy a pack of whatever the sale of the day is thinking you are going to get that bonus, but it’s never there. The card packs we are working on this month are ridiculous. I could have taken a vacation on what I’ve spent on “deals” to earn cards and for weeks I haven’t gotten a single useful card. I have had four incomplete pages for almost three weeks and the side game of the “St. Patty’s Day/Easter” album will be over in 3 days. Well done you for stringing me along to get me to spend so much. I can’t imagine how much other people have spent who have completed the gold albums!! I will be deleting this game. Spending so much and having nothing to show for it but an empty bank account is less than fun. It gets me the “Moron of the Year” award. I should stick to crosswords where at least I use some brain power.

author: H4yd3n_24
title: Base energy cap is buns
content: You would think as you level up higher and higher they would make the base energy cap a little higher as it takes more energy to complete orders the more you accomplish but nope your base energy cap is 100 whether you’re level 1 or level 100 guess they’re banking on people spending real cash to complete orders but I don’t think that gets people much further as it is because at a certain level it can take days to complete just one order at least give us the ability to watch more ads to get free energy the game is decently fun to play and I see multiple reviews that give great ideas on how to improve the game but seems like everyone gets the same cookie cutter response from the devs and all the updates that have came along since I’ve had this game has only made it worse for that reason I give this game 2 stars. If it’s more money you’re looking for out of the game LISTEN TO YOUR USERS/CUSTOMERS, BE DIFFERENT, STOP THE MONEY GRABBING UPDATES, people will spend money on a good product regardless you don’t have to force it, just take the advice you’re already receiving from the users.

author: Swirly84
title: Fraudulent ads, Money Hungry Devs
content:
Dev’s updated the game to include an update that allows for orders from all producers. “Retired” producers should stay retired. If you spend all of your time making orders for products you have no idea where they are coming from, you have no chance of progressing through the game because you’re going to run out of energy quickly making orders for anything, not just producers just unlocked. Then you’ll not be able to play because you’ll be waiting for energy to regenerate (which doesn’t happen quickly).
Also, can we talk about the fraudulent ads? There is no mystery in Travel Town. There is no one trying to kill anyone with poison because they’re being treated disrespectfully. 
In the game they all get along and treat each other with respect. This is just a ploy to get you to download the game and spend money in the game. 
There is no merging of small shells to make giant shells like the “Watermelon” game also. 
These developers are money hungry and every update is designed to take your money. Do yourself a favor and find another merge game that isn’t designed to take your money and has ads that actually show you what the game is about.

author: Jubran91
title: Really fun and addictive but....
content: I really do enjoy this game despite it being an energy based game. Unlike other energy based games, this game really gives you more options to get more energy coons and gems fast without having to pay for anything. The problem I'm having is that the quests calls for items that are rare to get. The maxed out "audio museum guide" for example, produces both paintings and statues. But you are more likely to get a bonus level 4 painting than a level 2 statue. Some quests want a level 3-5 statue but i would have spend over 200 energy sometimes more and wait for it to refill because i keep getting more paintings than statues. Same thing with other maxed out items that produce 2 different products. You get more of one of the two than other. There should be an update where the odds are more even or have one item that produces statues and one that produces the paintings. I have spent days trying to merge to a level 5 statue or tree or surf boards because i keep getting majority of the other items that I don't need

author: KateC69
title: Used to be fun
content: I loved playing this game but now it’s getting ridiculous.  It’s impossible to finish the daily challenges without spending actual money, most of the orders now take days to complete just because the 100 energy is used up in a couple of minutes to get maybe a quarter of the goal.  With the Carpenters Station I have 4 sanded wood blocks sitting in my inventory and it’s close to impossible to get the sander to finish them.  The orders for the items take multiple rounds of them to finish.  The cards you get for completing tasks, when you can or if you break down and purchase energy only give duplicates.  I haven’t had a single new card in over a week but I have up to 16 duplicates of several cards.  I’ve been missing the last 11 gold cards for almost 2 weeks now and of course those aren’t tradable for the lucky few that can get them.  I’ve spent an insane amount of money trying to get anywhere but I’m done.  I’ll be deleting this money grubbing game.  I hope the developers actually read the reviews of the many players who are deleting because they can’t keep spending money on a game that just wants more cash constantly.

author: Ariachic
title: Not enough ways to earn free energy
content: I’ve played this for a few months now and I love the game-the merge challenges are varied and the game doesn’t get boring. I discovered merge games when the match 3 games I played had them as side quests so I searched for them specifically and this is the best one out there I think. The only thing that drives me crazy is there is not enough ways to get free energy to make merges. The max it’ll build up to is 100 which in later levels doesn’t even let you get one item with an higher dollar value. I’m on level 66 and usually need around 400 energy to get the item I need. It takes about 2 hours to gain 100 energy without spending any money and that lasts about three minutes of play. I wish the developers would let the energy buildup without stopping. Or maybe stop it at 4-500. I love this game so much I have found myself spending upwards of $20/day just to play it for any meaningful amount of time. author: RoseJammies
title: Great game for 36 levels
content: I really love this game. Usually I'm bored to death by the plot lines in games but I love the conversations and the little people and always want to read more. I've limped along to level 47 hoping it would pick up again, but I'm about to give up. I've only got 3 goals at a time, and they're all for items that take a really long time to recharge, so I check in, tap the items a few times, and that's pretty much all that's worth doing. author: Red-The-Ninja
title: Decent But A Mess
content:

So getting energy to keep playing is not cheap and not easily accessible. I just got the game and already running into issues, which I believe, is a big problem. author: seline.81
title: Fun but OOF the bugs!!
content:

author: EveryUserNameIsTaken.exe
