author: notnova17
title: update killed the game.
content:
I loved this game. Was it annoying at times? Sure. But I was willing to look over and/or work around the annoyances because I was able to progress regardless. However, because of the last big update, I will not be playing anymore.

• Making it so that bubbles no longer give energy as well as making it so we only get 100 energy instead of chests after leveling up is insanity, especially considering the amount of energy it takes to achieve anything in this game. 

•The coin to chest ratio for rewards is absurd and the game has just become an endless grind for toolboxes. How can you expect anyone to get anywhere when we need 15 cement to level something up but only get a small tool box for completing the most complicated requests (that took me forever to do because of my lack of chances to gain energy).

• The storage!!! Not being able to toss or sell generators is taking up my space. As I progress, will my inventory ONLY be generators no longer in use? Will I have to sacrifice my space on the game board in order to have my storage? I’m not seeing an optimal end result here.

• “Rare” items suddenly never popping up and taking literal days-weeks for it to pop up when I need them but popping up a million times when I don’t? Seems like a weird glitch or something that needs to be fixed. 

• I can’t play during my commute on the train because for some reason I need a connection in order to play. I don’t understand why I would need an internet connection to play a game that doesn’t require you to connect to anyone else.

author: Travel town addict
title: I’m completely hooked but I have some questions and suggestions
content:
I was introduced to merging games 5 months ago (maybe longer) and I’ve logged in every day since and I currently have 3 great games (Travel Town, Seaside Escape, and Love and Pies for those interested) that I cannot stop playing. They’re not even just for boredom anymore. But with me playing these so much I have noticed slight flaws and I have some suggestions;
1. I’ve had one guy waiting for a mysterious fossil for 3 months so add some more hints such as where it comes from.
2. Whenever connection is lost it makes me backtrack a little bit so make it save data more often.
3. Sticker system is great but what you should really do is make a symbol above the title and images of generators showing what building they come from and when that building unlocks because it would be so helpful so I don’t have to sift through buildings to find the right stuff to upgrade.
4. Add in an auto upgrade system so you can go in settings and turn it on and as long as you have the resources to upgrade the building you upgrade then it will keep upgrading.
5. (Great feature from another merging game) Add a weekly event that you do every weekend or so like item bingo.
6. MY BIGGEST AND FINAL SUGGESTION! Upgrade the random loot system and rewards. Make the daily rewards not as challenging such as tons of coins. Also with the sort of navy blue crates are super hard to get. Make them slightly easier.

Developers I understand if things can’t be added because of errors or legal issues like my suggestion that is a feature from another game.

Sincerely, anonymous travel town addict

author: NandoLaFlare

author: Lulu S. Costa
title: Fun but needs some tweaks
content:
This game is fun, but the probability rates and other game design aspects can be extremely frustrating to the point where I quit the game from time to time. Here are a few suggestions I have. The stars indicate changes that I believe would make the most sense for both users and the developers. 

⭐️ - make it easier to make friends and trade cards in the app, i don’t like having to friend random people on facebook

- ability to trade more than 2 cards a day

- tweak the probability of getting new cards from packs. I have seen complaints from people who have spent loads of money to get zero new cards, which i imagine would be extremely demoralizing. I have had a similar experience, i don’t spend money for cards but i frequently open 3-6 packs in a row and get no new cards

⭐️ - more opportunities to watch ads for rewards. I understand the developers need to make money, but some of the requests are a bit ridiculous and it’s extremely difficult to progress without spending money

- if the above suggestion is untenable, decrease the amount of time it takes to refill energy

⭐️ - have an option to sell duplicates of golden cards, like getting a mystery box, exchanging for a three star card pack, or coins/diamonds

- view the refresh time when a producer is recharging

- see how much xp for a given upgrade

- see how much xp is needed to level up

Thank you for reading, and i hope some of these changes will be implemented to create a better balance between frustration and enjoyment in the game.

Like empty your wallet. It was fun for a day or two, until you realize you can’t do a literal single thing to progress, unless you wait several DAYS to even complete one or two objectives. VERY high cost for VERY little reward. This is easily one of the greediest developers I have come across, which is sad, because if they made it a more worthwhile game to play, I’d continue. author: Luigi0318
title: Full App Review
content:
Travel Town: Merge Adventure is a well-designed and engaging mobile game that successfully combines casual puzzle mechanics with rewarding long-term progression. Built around the popular merge gameplay format, the app offers a relaxing yet strategic experience that appeals to both new players and seasoned fans of the genre.

The core gameplay centers on merging items to create higher-level objects, which are then used to restore locations, complete tasks, and unlock new areas of the town. The mechanics are intuitive and easy to understand, allowing players to start immediately without feeling overwhelmed. As the game progresses, additional objectives and item chains introduce depth, keeping the experience engaging rather than repetitive.

Visually, Travel Town stands out with vibrant, polished artwork and smooth animations. Each restored area feels purposeful, reinforcing a sense of achievement and steady progression. The evolving environments and themed locations add charm and help maintain player motivation over time.

Performance and usability are strong points for the app. Travel Town runs smoothly across devices, with responsive controls and a clean, user-friendly interface that makes item management and navigation effortless. While the game includes energy systems and optional in-app purchases, these elements are balanced well enough that free-to-play users can still enjoy consistent progress without pressure.

Overall, Travel Town: Merge Adventure delivers a high-quality casual gaming experience that blends relaxation, strategy, and visual appeal. It is an excellent choice for players seeking a polished merge game that is enjoyable in both short sessions and extended play, making it a standout option in the mobile puzzle genre.

author: Isthis30letterslong?
title: Too Frustrating To Be Fun
content:
Apposed to other matching games, Travel Town is unique. It’s genuinely a lot more fun than most others on the App Store. That gave me hope that it also wouldn’t fall into the same unfortunate issues that 99% of free games nowadays do. That hope was misplaced, but all because of one feature! Literally just one!

This game requires you to have energy to do anything, which is already a little bit of a red flag. However if energy was easy to get and replenished quickly, I really wouldn’t have an issue. It doesn’t, though! If you want to play for over 5 minutes, you are shoehorned into spending gems (which are also difficult to acquire), spending real money, or just not playing. It feels like the devs are practically begging you not to play their game. 

Listen, I understand that making mobile games is really unsustainable without having SOME paid features, but I would much rather spend 0.99 on the game itself than downloading a game where my options are spend money repeatedly or just not play it. I don’t understand why the devs can’t take a page out of the book of some of the most beloved mobile games and just have cosmetic items cost money. The art style is fun and cute- people would definitely pay for them! 

Unfortunately, I realize saying all this is just screaming into the void. Mobile games like this are developed around the plan presented to the devs by the studio. No studio is willing to scrap that plan to make players happy. So, I guess, take as a warning. If you’re willing to spend upwards of $5 a week for a mobile game, have fun! If not, enjoy the first 10 minutes of gameplay before you have wait hours or uninstall.

title: You can’t enjoy this game without money
content:
This game is definitely addictive, but I would not recommend it. Once you reach the higher levels, it becomes very difficult to enjoy or make meaningful progress without spending money.

Energy refills extremely slowly. When you run out, you can either watch an ad for a very small amount of energy or spend money purchasing diamonds to get more. At that point, it essentially becomes a pay-to-play game.

The most frustrating part is the item production system. The algorithm seems intentionally designed to make the items you actually need harder to obtain. I have gone through 100 energy multiple times using the same producer without receiving the item I needed. Meanwhile, it continues producing items that are not useful for completing my current orders.

This creates a cycle where you burn through your energy, make very little progress, and are then encouraged to spend money to continue playing. What starts as a fun game eventually feels more like a system designed to push purchases than reward gameplay.

Play at your own risk. It can be entertaining, but once you reach the higher levels, expect slow progress, frustrating item drops, and constant pressure to spend money.

author: nikkikkuh
title: A whole rigged scam
content:

You’d think that if you’re willing to spend money on the game, you’d at least have a fair shot at better rewards, but that hasn’t been my experience at all. Instead, it feels like the game is built around frustrating players into making more purchases rather than rewarding them.

title: EXTREMELY DISCOURAGED!!
content:
I was thoroughly enjoying this game for months even going so far as to spend my own money, quite regularly, which wasn’t an issue as I was having fun and I’ll never feel bad for spending money to be happy.  I was genuinely having fun and one of my main goals was to fully complete the weekly goals, which takes a bit of time, consistency, AND money(just being honest) to do. I finally did it this past Sunday,  June 14 and my joy was ended swiftly once I realized I didn’t receive the end prize which happened to be 350 diamonds( a hefty and worth it prize). I immediately took screenshots and contacted support and they responded by essentially trying say that I did in fact receive the prize and going as far to tell me that I had almost the same amount of what the prize was already in my account prior to “receiving” the 350 diamonds. Like I stated I’ve been ROUTINELY playing this game everyday, I knew how many diamonds I had and it was no where near what they tried to claim I had or even remotely close the weekly goal prize. I restarted the game even updated it and nothing changed on my end. They sent 75 energy points to “make up” for the issue which it didn’t. I worked really hard to complete all the tasks, so feel cheated. Especially considering that I reached out a second time hoping if I clarified more they was understand that I simply did not receive the prize at all and idk what their end was showing but it simply did not match what I was seeing. They gave me the EXACT same response the second time. And now I have no desire to play the game anymore. I’ve easily spent hundreds of dollars on this game and while money isn’t an issue it simply sucks when your hard earned money feels wasted and you’ve lost something that was consistently bringing you joy. Anyway it was fun while it lasted I guess. 

TLDR: I didn’t receive weekly goals prize, support essentially tried gaslight me and make believe the prize was in my account when I could clearly see it wasn’t. After spending months enjoying this game and hundreds of my own money the desire to play is completely gone. Play this game and spend at your own risk you may not always receive the prizes you’re working towards.

content:

Otherwise, you do run out energy rather quickly, but keeping the auto producers going helps get some extra coin when create max items. I have also found that using less energy makes it last longer. author: AylondraM
title: Unfair Moderators in Trade Group
content: I LOVE this game. It helps me pass the time during my chemotherapy treatments and long drives to appointments. I used to have no issues with the trading group page on FB until I put up a post stating I can donate some cards. Apparently FB doesn’t like the words “donations” and they told me this so I fixed it but then it was never posted a flyer being fixed. Now a few weeks have passed and every day I put up a post to trade and it won’t be posted till 6-8 hours after. I brought this up to them and was told that it was because the moderators have a lot of posts to go through. I get that. BUT my posts did not take this like before as well as the fact that I’m pretty certain that NO ONE is waiting 6-8 hours for their trade post to be posted. This may not seem like a big deal but trading cards is one of the bases of the game. With my post going up at 12-1am in the morning, I am being hindered of this ability unless I scroll through EVERYONES post to trade every day. I’m pretty close to uninstalling this game mind you I DO put money into it so you’re close to losing business if this doesn’t get addressed and figured out why perfectly fine posts are not being treated fairly
